Context: 20. Commercial Employment after Retirement

Retired Group 'A' Officers should not accept any commercial employment before the expiry of one year from the date of their retirement without obtaining prior sanction. They are required to apply for permission in the revised Form 1. If they accept such appointments without prior sanction, Government may withhold the whole or part of the pension for such periods.
